description: This source file is a shell script containing Git test suite code, including setup, test cases, and reusable functions for testing git rev-list formatting, color output, encoding, and other git log features.

methods.name: test_format
methods.description: Defines a function to test git rev-list with specific format strings and compare output to expected results.

methods.name: test_pretty
methods.description: Defines a function to test pretty formats for rev-list output and compare to expected.

methods.name: has_color
methods.description: Checks if the output contains color codes, indicating colored output is enabled.

methods.name: has_no_color
methods.description: Checks if the output has no color codes, indicating color is disabled.
